interfaces.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.

members.name: Cedar 1
members.intention: Establish a food reserve and inspect available abilities.

personalIntent.goal: Secure safe food and discover available capabilities.
personalIntent.reason: Roots are known safe; public capability discovery requires the meeting location.
personalIntent.next: Gather roots, eat one, then consult the capability index.

shown: Root nutrition is 14 with zero known toxicity.
Use a separate root source from other members.

members.name: Cedar 2
members.intention: Maintain nutrition while investigating food preparation.

personalIntent.goal: Secure food and investigate practical food preparation.
personalIntent.reason: Known safe roots are nearby, but no preparation method is known.
personalIntent.next: Gather a reserve and request a feasible preparation capability.

shown: Reserve two roots after the planned meal; preparation effects remain unknown.

members.name: Cedar 3
members.intention: Build a food reserve and investigate local branches without destructive testing.

personalIntent.goal: Secure food and examine a nearby material source.
personalIntent.reason: A branch-bearing tree is visible, but material properties are unknown.
personalIntent.next: Gather safe roots, then observe the tree.

shown: Observation is not evidence of structural suitability until results are available.

members.name: Cedar 4
members.intention: Maintain nutrition and inspect the harvested root plant.

personalIntent.goal: Secure food and understand a local food source.
personalIntent.reason: Finite root stocks are visible; replenishment conditions are unknown.
personalIntent.next: Gather three roots and observe the source after harvesting.

shown: Initial source stock is six roots; replenishment has not been observed.

members.name: Cedar 5
members.intention: Maintain a reserve while investigating practical shelter.

personalIntent.goal: Secure food and investigate protection from outdoor exposure.
personalIntent.reason: Currently outdoors with no known shelter or construction ability.
personalIntent.next: Gather roots, eat, and request a feasible protective resting place.

shown: Exposure is observed, but present weather has caused no observed injury.

members.name: Cedar 6
members.intention: Explore nearby terrain with safe food in reserve.

personalIntent.goal: Secure food and make a short, cautious exploration.
personalIntent.reason: Known roots provide a reserve before moving toward the nearby eastern terrain edge.
personalIntent.progress: Healthy with no inventory; no local hazards observed.
personalIntent.next: Collect roots, eat, and move a short distance east.

shown: Exploration destination is nearby observed terrain, not an assumed resource.
